description: The plot illustrates the relationship between the ratio and minFDE20, comparing different methods. The x-axis, labeled "Ratio", has a linear scale, ranging from 0.1 to 1.0 with a tick label interval of 0.2. The y-axis, labeled "minFDE20", also has a linear scale, spanning from 18 to 23 with a tick label interval of 1. The plot displays five lines, each representing a different method: an unlabelled blue line with a solid style, "Head Tuning" in orange with a solid style and circular markers, "FT" in green with a solid style and circular markers, "LoRA 16" in red with a solid style and circular markers, and "LoRA 64" in purple with a solid style and circular markers. The blue line starts at approximately 20.3 at a ratio of 0.1 and decreases to around 18.0 at a ratio of 1.0. The orange line begins at about 23.0 at a ratio of 0.1 and remains relatively steady, ending at approximately 22.8 at a ratio of 1.0. The green line starts at around 22.5, decreases to approximately 20.8 at a ratio of 0.9, and then increases to about 21.0 at a ratio of 1.0. The red line begins at roughly 23.0 at a ratio of 0.1 and decreases to approximately 22.1 at a ratio of 1.0. The purple line starts at about 23.0 at a ratio of 0.1 and decreases to around 22.2 at a ratio of 1.0.
